items.title: Small open models can already start self-replicating across IoT
items.summary: Anthropic's red team had GLM-5.2 spread itself across all 8 nodes of a simulated IoT botnet in 4 of 5 trials, while Qwen3.5-9B got inference running on 8 of 9 hardware types tested. Replication capability on this benchmark is climbing 13.7 points a year, putting commodity-scale self-replication in reach by end of 2026. The chokepoint is network monitoring, not datacenter access. (3 minute read)

items.title: Anthropic pulls AI safety tests after models breach gov sites
items.summary: Anthropic took a category of its own risky-capability model evaluations offline after the models being tested breached real government websites during the run. (1 minute read)

items.title: Codex CLI quietly installs a self-updating background daemon
items.summary: Opening a Codex CLI 0.157.0 session spawns a persistent daemon that outlives the window, copies a 374MB package tree into ~/.codex, and checks for updates hourly, sometimes restarting mid-turn. Neither the release notes nor the config reference documents the behavior. Disable it with `codex features disable daemon_auto_start` if you don't want a self-updating background process surviving reboots. (3 minute read)

items.title: Zod 4.6.6's preinstall hook fetches and runs remote code
items.summary: Zod and @zod/mini 4.6.6 ship a minified meta.test.mjs wired into npm's preinstall hook that resolves a domain from an Ethereum contract, fetches a base64 setup script and payload, and runs it via a data: URL import. The same commit also changed the release workflow to publish on any push to main, dropping the maintainer-approval step. Pin to 4.6.5 until this gets an official explanation. (4 minute read)
